title: Ledgers, P&L, and cash flow
intro: Review posted activity and period balances: general ledger detail, trial balance, and balance sheet.

sections.title: General ledger
steps: Filter by account and date range to inspect posted lines.
Use this view to drill into journal activity for an account.
sections.caption: General ledger tab.

sections.title: Trial balance
sections.intro: Trial balance lists debit and credit totals by account for a period.
steps: Choose the period or as-of date your venue uses.
Confirm debits equal credits before relying on statements.
sections.caption: Trial balance tab.

sections.title: Balance sheet
steps: Review assets, liabilities, and equity for the selected date.
Other statement tabs (Profit & loss, Cash flow) follow the same pattern.
sections.caption: Balance sheet tab.

sections.title: Profit & loss
sections.intro: Income statement for the selected period: revenue, cost of sales, and operating expenses.
steps: Open Accounts and the Profit & loss tab.
Set the date range or period to match your reporting cycle.
Expand account groups to review category totals.
Export or print when the period is closed.
sections.caption: Profit & loss statement tab.

sections.title: Cash flow
sections.intro: Summarizes cash movement from operations, investing, and financing for the period.
steps: Open the Cash flow tab in Accounts.
Choose the same period used for other statements.
Review opening balance, net change, and closing cash position.
Use alongside P&L to explain cash vs. accrual differences.
sections.caption: Cash flow statement tab.
